scope.eligibility_rule: source match Date must be strictly earlier than the freeze UTC calendar date; same-day rows are excluded because exact completion timestamps are not guaranteed

feature_formula.shots_for_mean: arithmetic mean of team shots over exactly the most recent 10 eligible league matches
feature_formula.shots_on_target_for_mean: arithmetic mean of team shots on target over exactly the most recent 10 eligible league matches
feature_formula.shots_against_mean: arithmetic mean of opponent shots over exactly the most recent 10 eligible league matches
feature_formula.shots_on_target_against_mean: arithmetic mean of opponent shots on target over exactly the most recent 10 eligible league matches

ordering_rule: sort eligible team matches ascending by parsed Date then Time, then take the last 10
missing_data_rule: fail closed if fewer than 10 eligible matches exist or any required shot/SOT field in the selected lookback is missing/non-numeric
semantic_guardrails: SHOTS_SOT_PROXY is not xG, xT, OBV or VAEP
No goals, scoreline, result label, odds, target outcome or post-target row may enter the feature calculation
No manual weights, thresholds, sentiment, motivation or probability adjustments are emitted
The extractor is deterministic for a fixed source snapshot, freeze, aliases and target identity
